meta.title: Buyer places a surrogate bid for a vendor in the RFQ stage
gaps: Attach the offline Surrogate Bid Reference record.
Enter or verify Supplier Remarks for the vendor's instructions.
Verify that the Master QCS vendor column shows the exact blue "Surrogate Bid" marker next to the currency.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Attach the offline Surrogate Bid Reference record.; Enter or verify Supplier Remarks for the vendor's instructions.; Verify that the Master QCS vendor column shows the exact blue "Surrogate Bid" marker next to the currency.

steps.note: Open a suitable existing RFQ event with an eligible participating vendor who has not bid.
Navigate to the RFQ stage required for surrogate bidding.
Open the RFQ Participants list where eligible vendors expose Add Bid.
Enter and submit the buyer's bid on behalf of the first eligible vendor.
Verify that Procol accepted the surrogate bid submission.
Verify the RFQ response is attributed as a Surrogate Bid on the buyer's Responses view.
Open Master QCS to inspect the submitted vendor response.
Verify the QCS contains a real vendor column for the submitted bid.
Verify the QCS contains the entered surrogate bid value in the vendor's rate cell.
